SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT member_id) as members_changed_home_store
FROM dim_member

GROUP BY member_id

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT member_id) as members_with_changes
FROM (
  SELECT member_id, join_date, COUNT(DISTINCT CAST(valid_from AS DATE)) as versions
  FROM dim_member
  WHERE join_date >= '2025-04-28' AND join_date <= '2026-05-03'
  GROUP BY member_id, join_date
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT CAST(valid_from AS DATE)) > 1
) t
